method: Runs entirely in the browser with BigInt arithmetic. Dotted OIDs are encoded as the combined first value 40×first+second followed by later arcs, each in minimal unsigned big-endian base 128. The result includes universal tag 06 and a definite minimal BER length. Decoding accepts value bytes or one complete TLV, enforces SMIv2 limits of 2–128 arcs and 0..4294967295 per arc, restricts the first arc to 0..2 and the second to 0..39 for first arcs 0 and 1, and rejects non-minimal arcs, truncated values and inconsistent TLV lengths. OpenSSL 3.5.7 asn1parse supplied independent encode/decode fixtures and randomized oracle comparisons.
